subject: vitest
detail: Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit options from the root-level configuration.

test.error: FAIL: the inline project did not inherit the root setupFiles (extends is not on by default)

source.quote: Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit all options from the root-level configuration. This is controlled by the extends option, which is enabled by default since Vitest 5.0:
